name: bettercommit
description: Generate conventional commit messages from git diffs using AI (OpenCode Zen, OpenAI, OpenRouter & more) — directly in VS Code's Source Control panel. Forked from cihatksm/opencommit.

commitMessageGenerator.apiBaseUrl.description:
The API endpoint URL.
OpenCode Zen tiers:
- Free: https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions
- Go: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/chat/completions
- Go (Messages API): https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/messages

Other providers:
- OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions
- OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions
- Groq: https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions
- DeepSeek: https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions
- Anthropic: https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages
- Ollama (local): http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions
- Or type "opencode-cli" to use the local OpenCode CLI tool.

enumDescriptions: Auto-detect from apiBaseUrl (anthropic.com -> Anthropic Messages API, otherwise OpenAI-compatible).
Always use the OpenAI-compatible chat/completions client.
Always use the native Anthropic Messages API client (x-api-key + anthropic-version headers, top-level system field).
commitMessageGenerator.apiProvider.description: Which API protocol to use when calling the model. Use "auto" to detect from apiBaseUrl, or force "anthropic" to use the native Messages API.

commitMessageGenerator.model.description: The AI model to use. Any model name is accepted (custom models included). When switching models via the "🔄 Select Model" command or the model picker, the list is fetched live from your API endpoint (GET /v1/models for both OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic protocols), and you can always enter a custom model name manually.

commitMessageGenerator.promptModel.description: Show the model picker before the next generation. After you pick a model it is remembered and this setting is automatically turned off; use the "🔄 Select Model" command later to switch models (the list is re-fetched from the API every time).

commitMessageGenerator.conventionalCommi.description: Generate messages in Conventional Commit format (e.g., feat:, fix:, refactor:).

commitMessageGenerator.linuxKernelCommit.description: Generate messages in the Linux kernel commit format: "<subsystem>: <summary>" with a Signed-off-by trailer (uses your git user.name / user.email). Overrides conventionalCommit when enabled.

commitMessageGenerator.multiLine.description: Generate multi-line commit messages with a body explaining the changes.

commitMessageGenerator.maxDiffLength.description: Maximum diff length (characters) to send to the API. Larger diffs are truncated intelligently.
